description: Extract the document's dense post-secondary statistical detail tables. Include only printed table cells from the specified repeated row structures. Do not infer classifications, create derived totals, or include narrative notes. Preserve row order as printed within each table and across table continuations.

college_program_completion_rows.description: Include every program detail row from each college program-level completion table. Exclude table captions, column headers, notes, footnotes, institution total rows, and any row that is only a subtotal or grand total. Continue across page breaks until the next table caption, notes block, or non-detail section begins.

completions_2018_19.description: Integer from the 2018/19 column for this program completion row. Remove commas, spaces used as thousands separators, and surrounding parentheses; do not treat surrounding parentheses as a negative sign for completion counts. Keep printed 0 as integer 0. Use null only if the cell is truly blank, printed as a dash with no numeric value, or printed as N/A.
